mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS below 0.1%) indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as markets anticipate immediate stimulus effects.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.1%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 8.5% for three consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in consumer spending (RSAFS > 0.5% MoM) and stagnant employment (PAYEMS growth <= 0.1% MoM) indicates unsustainable consumption from savings depletion, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of interaction-triggered instances, or Rank IC for the interaction signal falls below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Low inflation (CPIAUCSL YoY change < 2.0%) creates a favorable environment for sustained monetary accommodation, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as equity valuations expand.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of low-inflation periods, or Rank IC for the signal remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO growth > 0.3% MoM) reflects expanding manufacturing output that correlates with stronger corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of INDPRO growth periods, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts falling below 600,000 units (HOUST < 600.0) signals contraction in the housing sector, reducing household wealth and business investment, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances, or Rank IC for the HOUST threshold signal remains below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong economic growth (GDPC1 QoQ growth > 1.0%) indicates robust corporate earnings momentum, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as markets price in sustained expansion.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of strong-growth periods, or Rank IC for the GDPC1 signal falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous Federal Funds rate cuts (FEDFUNDS decline) and high unemployment (UNRATE > 8.5%) signal aggressive policy response to economic weakness, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as stimulus expectations rise.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of interaction-triggered instances, or Rank IC for the interaction signal falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
